name: Tytuvėnai Monastery First Livestock Barn
scope: The standing exterior of Tytuvėnai Monastery First Livestock Barn. A long, single-storey brick and fieldstone barn with a gable roof, arched masonry entrances and small rectangular openings.
era: Standing exterior reconstructed from the surveyed pre-modern building and current mapped outline.

review.notes: Reviewed Qualla’s published originals first. The cleared exteriors depict the main church, chapel and gallery. None identifies this outbuilding clearly. The model uses the written heritage survey and mapped geometry.
